You know everything I am building, everything I hope to build and every place where I have been working with more confidence in myself than dependence on You. Your word says in 1 Corinthians 3:11, for no can lay my foundation other than the one already laid, which is Jesus Christ.  
Father, establish this truth in me. Let Christ have the place that belongs to Him. Teach me to build my life around Him and remain close to Him when progress comes. Keep my heart from drifting into self-reliance when things begin to work well. Search what I am building right now, Lord, and look beyond what others can see into the deepest intentions of my heart. Purity every motive that has become divided. Humble every part of me that has been touched by pride and free me from the fear that quietly influences my decisions. Bring my heart back to simple trust in You. Especially when I feel uncertain about what lies ahead. I would rather move slowly with Your presence than move quickly into something You have not asked me to build.

Lord Jesus, be present in my home and in the relationships, You have entrusted to me. Teach me to build with patience, truth, faithfulness and love. Give me wisdom to repair what has been damaged and humility to admit when I have been wrong. Let the people closest to me experience the fruit of a life that is truly submitted to You.
